rationale: Independent image source after UDD5 and VOC21: all 5000 COCO-Object81 validation images. Same eight-gain grid for Full and every coupled control. Main ablation uses Full-best gain, supplemented by independently retuned controls. Frozen aliases, routing beta=.5, score/background calibration unchanged. Dataset chosen for multiple-object context and independent source, not from a new cross-dataset component screen.
limitations: Validation labels select g0 for all methods; this is a development upper-bound analysis, not an independent held-out evaluation or universal component guarantee. Historical aliases/calibration also used labeled development. Legacy VIP-wide is only an internal branch control. Beta-zero timing retains unused routing computation. UniformBlend uses H=.5I, so alpha=g0/2 and includes extrapolation.
